queries.query: Online store for a gourmet food retailer: searchable product catalog, shopping cart with secure card checkout, order management with refunds, and a fast mobile storefront.
queries.rationale: 005 has catalog, cart/checkout and storefront; 006 has split order management and dispute/refund handling; 003 (payments gateway) is the near-miss to avoid.
queries.ground_truth:
Reference estimate for this project, in hours, derived from the historical budgets:
- Product catalog API with searchable catalog: 150 hours (BUD-2024-005::CATALOG-001)
- Cart and checkout service with card payment: 140 hours (BUD-2024-005::CART-002)
- Order management: 170 hours (BUD-2024-006::ORDER-002)
- Dispute and refund handling: 100 hours (BUD-2024-006::DISP-004)
- Mobile storefront PWA: 60 hours (BUD-2024-005::STORE-004)
Total: 620 hours.
